description: Defines a Playwright test class for interacting with the 'Flag Post Confirmation' dialog in Mattermost, including methods for verifying visibility, selecting reasons, and checking error messages.

classes.name: FlagPostConfirmationDialog
classes.description: A class encapsulating interactions with the flag post confirmation dialog in the Mattermost UI for testing purposes.

methods.name: fillFlagComment
methods.description: Fills the comment input with the provided text.

methods.name: selectFlagReason
methods.description: Selects a reason from the dropdown menu.

methods.name: toBeVisible
methods.description: Asserts that the dialog and key elements are visible.

methods.name: toContainPostText
methods.description: Asserts that the post message contains the specified text.

methods.name: notToBeVisible
methods.description: Asserts that the dialog and key elements are not visible.

methods.name: cannotFlagAlreadyFlaggedPostToBeVisible
methods.description: Checks that the error message for already flagged post is visible.

methods.name: requireCommentsForFlaggingPost
methods.description: Checks that the error message for missing comments is visible.

methods.name: cannotFlagPreviouslyRetainedPostToBeVisible
methods.description: Checks that the error message for previously retained post is visible.
